title: A heat map and minimap of selections
blurb: An article in a canvas coloured by how often each part has been selected, with the whole article drawn a second time as a minimap that stays in view. Starts with 40 simulated readers and adds your own selections.
question: Can a canvas colour text by how often it was selected and draw the same element again as a minimap?
result: Yes. One element can be drawn twice in a frame at different sizes, but only inside its own canvas.
